references.text: Previous verse introducing the offering of the first portion of dough (arisot) as a gift to the Lord
Ezekiel repeats the command to give the first portion of dough to the priests, who shall bring blessing upon the house
Nehemiah describes how the people committed themselves to bringing the first portion of dough to the priests in the house of the Lord
The basis for the terumah offering (heave offering) as a perpetual statute from the children of Israel
The command not to eat from the new harvest until the first portion has been given, as a perpetual statute throughout all generations
The first portion of grain, wine, and oil shall be given to the priests as their share
Call to honor the Lord with the first portion of all produce
